summary.zh-CN: 围绕腰痛与进行性行走困难，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for back pain and progressive walking difficulty.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别正常血糖性尿糖和小管蛋白尿。

text.zh-CN: 无胸髓外占位；轻度退变，双下肢深感觉传导径路阻滞。
text.en: No thoracic extramedullary mass; mild degenerative changes and impaired lower-limb deep sensory conduction.

text.zh-CN: 原报告换为恩替卡韦并补充相关营养/骨代谢治疗，数周磷改善；5 个月后恢复正常行走，尿小管指标明显下降，但部分仍异常。
text.en: The report switched to entecavir with nutritional/bone-metabolism support; phosphate improved over weeks. Walking was normal at five months and tubular markers fell markedly, though some remained abnormal.

prompt.zh-CN: 怎样统一生化与长期用药？
prompt.en: How do the biochemical findings and medication fit?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 近端小管多种重吸收障碍，考虑阿德福韦相关 Fanconi 综合征
text.en: Multiple proximal tubular losses suggest adefovir-associated Fanconi syndrome

feedback.zh-CN: 正常血糖伴尿糖、低磷低尿酸及小管蛋白支持。
feedback.en: Normoglycaemic glycosuria, low phosphate/urate and tubular proteins support this.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭肌酐变化小排除肾损害
text.en: Small creatinine change excludes renal injury

feedback.zh-CN: 小管障碍可早于明显滤过功能下降。
feedback.en: Tubular dysfunction may precede major filtration decline.

text.zh-CN: 全部由轻度脊柱退变解释
text.en: Mild spinal degeneration explains everything

feedback.zh-CN: 不能解释多项小管异常。
feedback.en: It cannot explain the tubular abnormalities.

prompt.en: How should treatment be safely reconsidered?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 肝病与肾脏团队调整可疑抗病毒药，同时维持 HBV 控制并监测小管指标
text.en: Hepatology/nephrology review the suspect antiviral while maintaining HBV control and monitoring tubular indices

feedback.zh-CN: 不能自行停掉所有抗病毒治疗。
feedback.en: Do not simply abandon all antiviral treatment.

text.zh-CN: 继续原药，只处理腰痛
text.en: Continue unchanged medication and treat back pain alone

feedback.zh-CN: 遗漏可能持续的药物损伤。
feedback.en: That misses possible ongoing drug injury.

text.zh-CN: 自行停所有 HBV 药，不再随访
text.en: Stop every HBV drug without follow-up

prompt.zh-CN: 如何评价停药后步态恢复？
prompt.en: How should recovery after withdrawal be judged?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 支持药物关联，但脊髓及周围神经的独立致病机制未证明
text.en: It supports drug association without proving an independent spinal/peripheral mechanism

feedback.zh-CN: 同时纠正代谢并换药，不能分离各项作用。
feedback.en: Metabolic treatment and antiviral change occurred together.

text.zh-CN: 证明所有神经症状都是直接神经毒性

text.zh-CN: 一次磷正常就无需小管随访
text.en: One normal phosphate removes the need for tubular follow-up

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 阿德福韦相关近端小管障碍与低磷、行走异常相伴；改善支持关联而非全部机制确证。
conclusion.en: Adefovir-associated proximal tubular dysfunction accompanied hypophosphataemia and gait disturbance; improvement supports association, not every mechanism.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肌酐不能替代近端小管指标。
keyReasoning.en: Creatinine does not replace proximal tubular measures.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 说明书列有 Fanconi 与低磷风险。
keyReasoning.en: Product information lists Fanconi syndrome and hypophosphataemia.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 换药时兼顾乙肝持续控制。
keyReasoning.en: Maintain hepatitis B control when changing treatment.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.

unknowns.zh-CN: 尿磷分数排泄、完整神经病因评估与更多远期随访未载。
